items.heading: Communication Is a Set
items.text: Communication is a set of habits: listening, structuring a message, speaking clearly, writing short and asking good questions. It improves when you practise on real tasks and get feedback from someone else.

items.heading: A Simple Measure Works Better
items.text: A simple measure works better than a score. Record a two-minute explanation of something you know, listen back, and count filler words, unclear sentences and moments where a stranger would be lost. Repeat weekly and compare.

items.heading: Consulting, Coaching, Training and Advisory
items.text: Consulting, coaching, training and advisory work are sold on trust and clarity. See consulting as a career .
